title: lakmisa numuk rooci
intro: Nabiyyih aydaaditteh addat, sabri keenik kinnaaneh addat culteh tan rooci suge. Ximoo kee waktit, oson qaago yabbixen, wakti sinni ceelalloh qibaadah cogdal kibal luk. atu ta angoyya sinni muucih cuumi baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu farmoytit buxah marat ooboke, takkay immay yok kaxxa aqayyaare anu kaxxam kiciyyo awkak temeete.
Anu yi baxi tabisse soonok aysinuk maabitina geeeh, kay amaanah meysiteh.
intiita yok qaddowteh rookah, uxih anu yallih racmattal imaan weeh.
Yok bayte baxih suruy allak yoo gufeeh, tokkeek qagitak agle xayyowtem eexegeh.
Yi buxah mari dumaahi mabla kibbimte wak gadda gacsaanam kee yi intiita tuduureh.
Anu qabalat rade kamis xayyoowe num kinniyo, dubuk sarra yi mabla dayliseh yan kamis geeh.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
